title: Tame Discrete Sets on Affine Semisimple Homogeneous Spaces
summary: Winkelmann conjectures that every smooth flexible complex affine variety of dimension at least two is a Rosay--Rudin space. We verify this for every positive-dimensional quotient $G/H$ with $G$ a connected complex semisimple algebraic group and $H$ a closed connected reductive subgroup. Weak and strong tameness coincide, every injection between tame discrete sets extends to a holomorphic automorphism, and complements of tame, finite, or empty sets are Oka.
